decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the first-mint ticket exception and adjusts the expected visible ticket total accordingly.
The metadata rule requires displaying commissions that were actually awarded; the absence of a first-mint commission does not change that rule.
The one-off commission and ticket exception does not change which successfully minted NFTs the dashboard must show.
The first no-referral mint's commission and ticket treatment does not change referral-count visibility.
Public referral statistics remain based on recorded referral activity, which is unaffected by the first no-referral mint exception.
The accounting exception has no effect on NFT image or media rendering behavior.
The countdown continues to measure sales remaining until the draw; the first-mint reward exception does not alter that measure.
The accepted exception does not change the rule that public mint statistics count successfully completed mints.
The source does not establish any change to prize-pool funding or displayed prize-pool totals.
The client explicitly treats the first-mint case as a completed one-off with no forward impact, so no FAQ-content change is necessarily entailed.
A same-message MODIFY already records that mint #1 awards no commission when no existing NFT holder is available.
A same-message MODIFY already records that mint #1 awards no ticket when no earlier NFT exists for random selection.
